title: A tidier image-editor workflow
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: cleaner editor controls, a quieter text experience, and a simpler setup for multi-service contributors.

The image editor's Reference Images interface got a cleanup, while button styling was made more consistent across the site. Small interface work, but fewer different ways for a button to behave is generally good news.

The ad system was disabled globally on text.pollinations.ai, keeping the text endpoint focused on producing text rather than additional scenery.

A root package.json now gives contributors a clearer entry point for working across Pollinations' multiple services.

highlights.title: New Models
highlights.text: Added `perplexity-fast`, `perplexity-reasoning`, and `naughty` (Mistral Nemo) to the [Text API](https://enter.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: OpenAI Compatibility
highlights.text: New standard `/v1/chat/completions` endpoints allow seamless integration with existing OpenAI SDKs. Check [API Docs](https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/docs).

highlights.title: Exact Dimensions
highlights.text: Removed auto-scaling limits—generate images in specific resolutions (e.g., 1536x1024) without modification via the [Image API](https://enter.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Raw Output API
highlights.text: GET requests to text and audio endpoints now return raw text strings or MP3 files instead of JSON for easier browser usage.
